::: {.callout-note}
## What this is

A working analysis, not a finished study. Every clade call, site call and candidate here is a
prediction from sequence and structure; **no enzyme in this report has been expressed or
assayed by us.** Section 7 states the limitations and section 4 reports the results that came
out negative, including four attempts to extend the model that failed their own tests.

The report is explicit about where it stops: identifying PF01328 sites is validated (95/95
against the published structure-based matrix), ranking clade-V-like pockets is reliable for
ordering candidates, and predicting whether an arbitrary protein is an active peroxygenase
**is not reliable** (out-of-clade AUC 0.556). Section 3 explains why that is arithmetic rather
than something reanalysis can fix.

The source of truth is
[`analysis/enzymes_UPO/`](https://github.com/1KFG/delta-gain-fungi/tree/main/analysis/enzymes_UPO)
in the repository; this page renders `REPORT.md` from that directory, so the two cannot drift.
The 45 documents it synthesizes are listed at the end, and the per-protein table it describes
is in the repository beside the code that built it.
:::
